newScope: Providers is one of the seven current Settings navigation routes, but it was absent from the fixed fidelity denominator.

The state includes provider-health policy, Add and Refresh entry points, ordered provider-instance cards, collapsed and expanded card states, enablement controls, update affordances, and the Add Provider wizard.
Existing model-picker and provider-update evidence does not certify this Settings management surface.
productLoss: Web authority renders Health check interval as the first 896px row. Lynx omits it.
Web authority keeps Add provider instance behind a 24px header action that opens a wizard. Lynx renders a persistent 896x115 inline create form and has no Add trigger.
Web authority orders provider cards Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode. Lynx orders Claude before Codex.
Web provider cards measure approximately 896x67-71 with right-aligned expand and enable controls. Lynx cards measure 896x124-134, and their controls stack toward the left.
The extra inline form and oversized cards move the Lynx Providers section from y=88 to y=-0.5 in the retained frame.
harnessMismatch: The initial exploratory run had no Providers-specific measurement contract and also printed fileEditingSaveEvidence as failed for an unrelated state. The committed harness now measures Providers explicitly and reports file-save evidence as not required.

The first post-harness capture emitted one Web background VCS status error. It was rejected, not filtered. A complete repeat from the same immutable source snapshot produced a clean console and the same Providers content and geometry failures.
Older tracked Native screenshots show an obsolete eight-item Settings navigation including Beta and therefore cannot certify the current seven-route product.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Settings navigation rows remain 32px on Web and 44px on Lynx for coarse-pointer density; this known platform delta is outside the Providers content repair.
acceptedRenderingNoise: Subpixel Web card heights and font rasterization are not treated as structural loss by themselves.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Registration expands the fixed denominator before repair. The clean Browser baseline proves identity and product loss but supplies no Native evidence. All twelve new Lynx-for-Web and Native cells enter as conservative unknown; a separate pre-fix measurement point may credit only the valid Browser dimensions.

denominatorChange.reason: Providers Settings is a distinct user-reachable P1 management surface absent from the existing Settings, model-picker, and provider-update states.
